evidence.observation: Close-up of A shows a small white ring at the tail base on the dark body.
evidence.distinguishes_because: This tail marking is a persistent individual feature of A.

evidence.observation: Close-up of X shows the same small white tail-base ring at the equivalent tail position.
evidence.distinguishes_because: X shares A's tail marking, supporting X=A rather than X=B.

evidence.observation: Close-up of B lacks the distinct white tail-base ring seen on A and X.
evidence.distinguishes_because: B does not match X's marked tail, so X is less likely to be B.

decision.limitation: Low contrast, motion blur, and differing pose/lighting can obscure tail markings; identity is inferred from one persistent marking rather than a side-by-side same-pose match.
